implementations.core_override: Both native libraries use pinned Mops core@2.5.0. CandidX declares core 1.0.0; compatibility and parity were verified with 2.5.0.
implementations.normalize_phase: Native CandidX canonicalize on preencoded ordinary Candid; secondary context only

sha256_inputs.generator: xorshift32, low byte after each step

measurement_protocol.synchronous_gc: included in instruction count; reclaimed_bytes reported

methodology: Same compiler and actor for all implementations; fresh canister per workload/trial. Inputs are configured outside measurement. Output is cleared and four GC increments run before each phase. Raw performanceCounter(0) deltas include counter/assignment overhead; control is reported separately. Native CandidX includes to_candid plus canonicalize and successful Result unwrapping. Normalize is canonicalize alone on ordinary bytes saved outside measurement. Native SHA is Mops sha2 Sha256.fromBlob(#sha256, input). Synchronous GC, if any, is included and reported; plugin phases require zero reclamation. Reply encoding, input setup, and message-end GC are outside the interval.
correctness: Every canonical Candid output is checked against host canonicalization of the ordinary Candid output for the same input. Both SHA implementations are checked against Python hashlib digests. Equivalent phases must return identical bytes.
